patch.value: Generate release notes from immutable tracker milestones
Add a backend-neutral immutable release source and a tracker milestone creation command for plain-directory and SDK database snapshots.

Plain-directory and synthetic database milestones generate identical notes; changed milestone membership refuses; git-tag behavior remains separately tested; typed SDK and CLI create and generate without git; compact agent receipts and typed refusals with remedies; README and example; measured validation on a read-only public tracker copy; npm and Bun release gates at unchanged thresholds; behavioral revert proof.
